description: This file defines the class GroupCountBased, which extends an abstract class and provides specific implementations for processing regex-based route groups in a fast route data generator. It includes methods for handling chunk sizes and processing regex routes for pattern matching within a routing system.

classes.name: GroupCountBased
classes.description: A class that extends RegexBasedAbstract to provide chunked processing and regex generation for route grouping based on variable count.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the approximate size of chunks for data processing (fixed at 10).

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a chunk of regex to route mappings, generates combined regex pattern, and constructs a route map based on variable counts.
